name: GroupLabel
description: Fieldset/legend-shaped label used by `CheckboxGroup`, `FormGroup`, and other multi-control groupings. Provides the group's accessible name without forcing every child input to repeat it.

ariaRequirements: Renders a `<label>` element; pair with a fieldset or use `aria-labelledby` on the group container so the legend becomes the group's accessible name.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Bucket-1 beta port: keyboard/ARIA contract reviewed, ForcedColors story added, Storybook axe gate (parameters.a11y.test: error). 2026-07-12 — beta→stable: 4-mode AT (base/light/dark/forced-colors) captured on a non-6010 Storybook for all required stories; accessibility tree and real-browser forced-colors confirmed; real Figma component built (replacing the placeholder link). 5 production consumers (form field groups).

forbiddenUse: Use as a label for a single input — that is `Label`.
Style as a heading — screen readers will navigate to it as a heading and miss the group it labels.
dense: heading-style label for a cluster of related controls; htmlFor targets the primary control; for true same-name sets use FormField or RadioGroup (fieldset legend)

usage.description: GroupLabel is a heavier, heading-style label for a cluster of related controls, such as a filter row or a composite input. It renders a real label pointing at the primary control. For true groups of same-name controls, prefer FormField or RadioGroup, whose fieldset legend names every control at once.

bestPractices.description: Point htmlFor at the control that should receive focus when the text is clicked.
Use it as the visual header of a compound widget that is not a fieldset.
Pair with required to show the asterisk when the underlying group must be filled.
Keep the text a noun phrase (Delivery address), matching Label's tone.
Do not use GroupLabel instead of a fieldset legend for radio or checkbox sets; assistive tech only announces a legend on every contained control.
Do not nest interactive elements inside it; it is a label, and clicks forward to the target control.
